notes_for_editor: The only source for this tower is one row of the tnlandforms GA list (GA297, coordinates, elevation, GFC 001, BLL-50810). No NHLR, FFLOS, Vanishing Georgia or Wikimedia Commons page in our caches names it, and two web searches turned up no lookout history. The list's naming note applies because GA297 is above 73, so 'Elberton' is a label. The list gives elevations with no unit on the page, so the story now gives 678 with no unit. The tower record (data/towers/ga/us-ga-elberton.json) reads it as feet and has elevation_m 206.7; that conversion is not in any source and needs the editor's decision. Status, build date, design, staffing and access are all unknown. The GFC county contact page is cited only for the Elbert County office location, which describes the county unit, not this tower; the story no longer says that office answers tower access questions. The Savannah Morning News 2006 article on Georgia fire towers (https://web.archive.org/web/20121007034909/http://savannahnow.com/news/2006-07-15/fire-towers-are-fading-history) gives statewide staffing figures but does not name this site, so it is not used. Story is about 150 words. Verification 2026-10-21: one unsourced unit fixed, one implied access role removed, one paraphrase reworded; all 5 quotes found on the first check.
